note_en: 一边……一边…… means two actions happening at the same time: 主播一边介绍产品，一边回答观众的问题 "the host introduces the products while answering viewers' questions." English uses "while" or "as" to join the two clauses, but Chinese puts 一边 in front of each verb and keeps the same subject throughout. Both actions should be ongoing, deliberate ones, not one-off events.
